purpose: Permit source acquisition and hashing without exposing C13+ labels, costs, ground truth, or telemetry contents to the model-development role.

access_classes.public_non_label_metadata: May be inspected for source identity, licensing, scenario-counting, and download planning.
access_classes.sealed_telemetry_payload: May be downloaded and hashed by an isolated curator but not opened by the model-development role.
access_classes.curator_only_boundary_material: May be inspected only by the isolated curator to prove complete execution boundaries and deduplicate cases.
access_classes.ground_truth_custodian_only: Contains labels, expected-versus-observed validation, outcomes, or adjudication material and remains sealed until authorized one-shot execution.
access_classes.duplicate_or_noncase_view: Must not create an additional case or artifact-derived pseudo-case.

public_non_label_metadata: Mendeley public API file names, sizes, and SHA-256 values
source_rules.required_before_any_case_credit: An isolated curator must prove a unique complete execution boundary, all-host capture, unique chain definition, and unique telemetry hash for each retained scenario; subset-masked definitions receive no credit until separability is proven.

sealed_telemetry_payload: scenario-specific AttackMate and Caldera log/traffic archives
curator_only_boundary_material: execution logs needed to bind one complete capture to each scenario definition
source_rules.required_before_any_case_credit: The curator must retain at most one preselected complete execution per scenario family and prove no definition or capture overlap with AIT Log Data Set or CAM-LDS.

public_non_label_metadata: Zenodo record, author metadata, file names, sizes, and MD5 values
curator_only_boundary_material: execution timing and device-coverage evidence needed to bind one complete capture to the public scenario definition
duplicate_or_noncase_view: robot, webcam, network, and other device views
source_rules.required_before_any_case_credit: The curator may credit at most one case and must prove complete execution identity, sufficient campaign-wide coverage, and no AttackMate-family or cross-source overlap.

public_non_label_metadata: Zenodo record, consortium and project identity, archive names, sizes, checksums, and public three-storyline description
curator_only_boundary_material: variant definitions and complete-execution coverage material
duplicate_or_noncase_view: hosts, sensors, logs, alerts, graph views, and time slices
source_rules.required_before_any_case_credit: The curator may credit at most one preselected complete execution for each of SL100, SL300, and SL700 and must hash the retained archives and prove definition, capture, and cross-source uniqueness.

public_non_label_metadata: Zenodo record, Data in Brief article, file names, sizes, checksums, date ranges, and aggregate-versus-partition description
sealed_telemetry_payload: Mendeley Combine and Processed Version aggregate files
curator_only_boundary_material: any record-level material needed to identify complete execution start/end boundaries and capture coverage
ground_truth_custodian_only: record labels, rule descriptions, TTP mappings, payloads, commands, hashes, and adjudicated malicious-versus-general fields
duplicate_or_noncase_view: rows, dates, hosts, sensors, and MITRE mappings
source_rules.required_before_any_case_credit: Current credit is zero. Only an isolated curator may propose positive credit after proving a complete unique chain execution and sufficient telemetry coverage without exposing payloads, labels, costs, or outcomes to model developers.

public_non_label_metadata: Zenodo record, annual release relation, file names, sizes, and checksums
curator_only_boundary_material: annual exercise execution boundary and full-host coverage material
source_rules.required_before_any_case_credit: The curator may credit at most one complete case per annual exercise capture and must keep LSPR23 and LSPR24 in one source cluster for dependence sensitivity analysis.
